The '''Glite-Ven system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to the year [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] according to the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|dating system]] used by sources such as ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Glite-Ven hostilities]] had occurred within the system.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Glite-Ven hostilities]]|system=Glite-Ven [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Glite-Ven system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square R-3.<ref name="TEA" />
